company.name: Kamino
company.shortDescription: Kamino offers a web-based application that provides its users with directions and information of places to plan walking tours.
company.description:
Kamino is a mobile application that provides its users with tools to create and enjoy walking tours, and plan trips. It is an interactive companion that grants access to user generated explorations of a city.

Kamino provides its users with the ability to discover the local reserves in their neighborhood and beyond. It was launched by Louis Huynh and Roger Obando.
